entries.title: Bannerline is now on games.radgh.com
items: Line War: guard your Keep with a hero while you spend gold sending units down your rival's field. The last team still flying banners wins.
Four armies of twelve units each, and five heroes (Warrior, Ranger, Pyromancer, Druid, Engineer) with five skills and a talent.
Spend gold in the town behind your Keep: hire units, buy gear, train your whole army and call down one-shot powers.
Hunters vs Farmers: hide, farm and build an army in a forest while the hunters try to find you.
A short campaign, Banners of the Vale, with the Warrior's five missions.
Play against the computer at three levels, two players on one screen, or online with a room code. Keyboard, mouse and controllers all work.
New: a What's new list and a Credits page on the title screen and in the pause menu.
